title: Profile card
description: The signed-in person at the foot of the sidebar: Avatar, full name and last login. A long name truncates with an ellipsis. Collapsed, only the Avatar shows, centred, with no card. Clicking the card opens a menu above it with Account preferences and Logout. Expanded, a gear button sits at the right.
